observations_and_findings.classification: Historical 059 Segovb READ-L11-452 existing open conditional from_span question, independently reassessed at 95e; no automatic new unique count.
observations_and_findings.mechanism: AuthoredArmorCoverage::try_from(Vec<ArmorCoverageSegment>) rejects nonfinite, out-of-range or reversed endpoints and serde deserialization routes through it, but the public from_span inserts any public raw ArmorCoverageSpan directly. For example, a caller supplying start=-0.1 and end=0.3 would construct a coverage value which its own Vec-based serialized representation rejects on deserialization. contains then uses this admitted span in hit-surface/telemetry selection. This is static type/control-flow reasoning, not an executed fixture.
observations_and_findings.conditions_and_limits: Caller must supply a span outside the checked domain through from_span; the inspected innate producer supplies centered(1.0), and a selected profile source uses finite literal coverage. No supported product producer, malformed data path or gameplay failure is established; centered with NaN is another conditional admission concern. Zero-width intervals are intentionally not automatically invalidated by the Vec gate.
observations_and_findings.future_repair_direction: Reconcile constructors, serde and producer boundary so accepted spans share one deliberate finite ordered interval policy; preserve valid empty intervals and explicitly handle invalid inputs, without adding compatibility fallbacks. Trace real producers before selecting enforcement and connect, do not duplicate, historical 059 question.

observations_and_findings.classification: Current conditional downstream consequence related to /root/rig_identity CATALOG-SURFACE-VALIDATION-BOUNDARY and 059 452; distinct operation, not an automatic unique finding or alias.
observations_and_findings.mechanism: The public deserializable placement and surface DTOs expose Vecs, while from_placement collects one segment per retained matching region and calls expect after the 16-segment capacity check. A directly constructed raw placement with a coverage-1 span containing 17 Chest regions would reach 17 retained segments and fail this expect. The inspected catalog validator rejects such a total and also requires valid contiguous regions; no claim that this malformed shape passes that validator.
observations_and_findings.conditions_and_limits: Requires an alternate raw constructor/deserializer path to pass an oversized placement into projection. The selected source call is a consumer, but bypass of the catalog validator is not demonstrated. No fixture, runtime, encounter or panic was executed; source-level case is a conditional proof of API precondition. The earlier occupancy/surface packet identifies the public DTO versus validation boundary, without alleging bypass.
observations_and_findings.future_repair_direction: Identify actual producers and make the placement-validation/capacity guarantee explicit at the owning admission boundary, or propagate an appropriate projection error; preserve legitimate disconnected segments and valid coverage semantics. Reconcile duplicate/alias decisions centrally.

observations_and_findings.classification: Previously noted 059 READ-L11-452 open precondition, reassessed source only; not an accepted or newly counted product defect.
observations_and_findings.mechanism: PlateGridEnd::Last.row(rows) subtracts one from raw u32 rows; rows=0 underflows, with overflow behavior depending on compiler settings. First also names a row even for an empty grid.
observations_and_findings.conditions_and_limits: The selected global navigation had no literal .incoming.row or .edge.row matches, which does not prove no alternate call syntax, indirect usage, or downstream external caller. No allowed producer has been shown to pass zero and no runtime executed.
observations_and_findings.future_repair_direction: Trace all row-count producers/consumers, express a nonempty grid invariant or explicit error at the right boundary if reachable; preserve endpoint identity and mechanical course semantics.

thirteen_lenses.producer_propagation: Typed Slot indices survive host packing; selected puff pattern preserves textile appearance to fitted component and preview. Trace complete source contracts and validate material projections at actual boundaries.
thirteen_lenses.existing_type_owners: Role, topology face, mechanical course and source sRGB color have distinct owners. ArmorCoverageSpan public scalar endpoints remain a checked interval candidate at the boundary, not a mandate to wrap every native float.
thirteen_lenses.admission_contracts: from_span bypasses checked Vec admission; from_placement depends on catalog capacity guarantees, both conditional on caller provenance. Serde DTO construction does not itself prove catalog semantic validation.
thirteen_lenses.invariant_operations: GridEnd::Last subtracts one on rows=0; no valid zero producer shown. Coverage interval contains and conversion are actual examined operations; exact conditions and serde asymmetry retained.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate_states: Mount parent/course/follow and component buffer ranges require contextual graph and buffer invariants; checked catalog segment count is not encoded by the public placement DTO. No invalid actual product aggregate established.
thirteen_lenses.type_ownership: Keep armor component/face/mount and helmet native code ownership local; game item coverage geometry is a separate combat projection. Current textile color relocated to shared appearance owner; preserving file or public alias is not required.
thirteen_lenses.redundant_authority: Whole-item scalar coverage and selected-part geometry mean different things per 774 contract023. Material and textile projections coexist; evidence does not prove drift in the inspected path.
thirteen_lenses.behavior_preservation: Old color conversion and new color owner share channel transformation; new finish, opacity and material fields add semantics. Do not assert entire old/new behavior equivalent or retain old schema for compatibility.
thirteen_lenses.enum_shapes: PlateFace, GridEnd, JointMotion and component roles express closed choices; Option mount and material require actual producer policy before tighter enum-payload proposal.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: Shared helmet code WGSL source is derived from one enum declaration; role name and trim name are parallel explicit match outputs. Their literals may be output format boundaries, not proven defects.
thirteen_lenses.type_granularity: Unit interval semantics apply to coverage spans and particular opacity/follow roles only after owner policy; general Permille supports values over one elsewhere. Component role is not a plate face or rig joint.
thirteen_lenses.magic_strings: Serialization snake_case and component display/export names are deliberate format surfaces; catalog validator text and string region mappings warrant owner alignment, without asserting mismatch.
thirteen_lenses.magic_numbers: Colors /255, alpha and finish roughness are source/native representation and design policies; region/count limits are semantic; numeric case evidence is conditional, not a call to indiscriminately name every literal.
